question:
Two different positions of the same die are shown below. What is the number on the face opposite to the one having 2 ?

\ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6ab6d02cd43c02ebd883c23fbc64aa5a178749b5ba5c0d2cb5dfd471dc9b9d2.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From the given two different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 5 is common on both the dices, it is clear that 6, 4, 3, and 1 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 2 will be opposite to it.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/704a06a5803b5de0c3ff5a598a5d43c60c3637d3d828666368cfdb763f73edb1.png] 

Opposite pairs:

6 → 3

4 → 1

5 → 2

So, the opposite side of "2" will be side "5".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
